name: Kai Denpa, Hitori, Koi Shinchuu
source:
Novel game about a reclusive girl and the various cases she gets involved in.
Solve dark cases with a truant girl, Takamine, or get caught up in them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ331203.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一部围绕闭门不出的少女，以及她卷入的各种案件展开的文字冒险游戏。
与拒绝上学的少女高峰一起解决阴暗的案件，或是深陷其中。

[译自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ331203.html]DLsite[/url]]
